description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named EmployeeAllowedLicenseSearchFilterParams used for filtering search results related to employee allowed licenses in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties and methods to manage the employee number filter criteria.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedLicenseSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying filters when searching for employee allowed licenses, including setting and getting employee number, and default sort field 'l.name'.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params with default sort field 'l.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter value, or null if not set.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value.
